basic_details.job_title: MAHE Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Senior Project Assistant/ DEO Posts
basic_details.short_information: Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) has announced 1 project-based vacancy for the Senior Project Assistant / Data Entry Operator post in Manipal, with a project duration of one year. The pay for the post is Rs. 20,000. Candidates applying for this position require a qualification of Graduation (BSc or equivalent) and above. Eligible applicants must send detailed CVs by email on or before 15 October 2026, ensuring the job code is mentioned in the subject line of the application. The selection process consists of the shortlisting of candidates followed by an interview.

important_dates.interview_date: To be communicated to shortlisted candidates via email

qualification.details: Work experience in data entry, clinical coordination, or hospital administration preferred. Comfortable using smartphones, mobile apps, and basic computer tools. Strong attention to detail and accuracy in transcribing clinical information. Fluency in Kannada, Tulu, and English (Hindi a plus) — essential for patient and caregiver interaction in Manipal. Good interpersonal skills and patience when working with recovering patients and anxious caregivers. Having basic technical knowledge of MS Excel.

how_to_apply: Prepare a detailed CV with all required qualifications and experience details.
Send the detailed CV to the official email address: [email protected].
Ensure the job code Application for Senior Project Assistant/Data Entry Operator –KMC, Manipal is strictly mentioned in the subject line of the application email.
Submit the application on or before October 15, 2026.

rows.details: Department of Radiation Oncology, Kasturba Medical College (KMC), Manipal
Validation of a Digital Health App (Recoup App) for Radiation Oncology Patients and Informal Caregivers (DHARE)
In collaboration with POSHA Healthtech Private Limited
Senior Project Assistant / Data Entry Operator

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential Qualification: Graduation (BSc or equivalent) and above, preferably with work experience in health sciences and having basic technical knowledge of MS Excel, SPSS, and Google survey. Work experience in data entry, clinical coordination, or hospital administration preferred. Comfortable using smartphones, mobile apps, and basic computer tools. Strong attention to detail and accuracy in transcribing clinical information. Fluency in Kannada, Tulu, and English (Hindi a plus) — essential for patient and caregiver interaction in Manipal. Good interpersonal skills and patience when working with recovering patients and anxious caregivers. Having basic technical knowledge of MS Excel.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 20,000/- per month. The duration of the project is one year.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for MAHE Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare a detailed CV with all required qualifications and experience details. Send the detailed CV to the official email address: [email protected] . Ensure the job code Application for Senior Project Assistant/Data Entry Operator –KMC, Manipal is strictly mentioned in the subject line of the application email. Submit the application on or before October 15, 2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received by the last date will be evaluated. Shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail about the interview date. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
